summary: JS: kotlinUpgradePackageLock doesn't fully update package-lock.json
description:
Running `kotlinUpgradePackageLock` doesn't always correctly update `package-lock.json`. There are times where it has to be run with `--rerun-tasks`, other times where it has to be run with `--rerun-tasks --no-configuration-cache --no-build-cache`, and other times where `./gradlew clean` has to be run followed by `./gradlew kotlinUpgradePackageLock --rerun-tasks --no-configuration-cache --no-build-cache`.

Maybe this is a duplicate of https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KT-69684?

The original issue report was about the `wasmJsRun` task failing; the original context is below.

Running the `wasmJsRun` (or `wasmJsBrowserProductionRun`, etc...) tasks in Kotlin 2.0.20 are broken:

```
> Task :samples:todo:webWasmApp:wasmJsBrowserProductionRun FAILED
[webpack-cli] For using 'serve' command you need to install: 'webpack-dev-server' package.
[webpack-cli] Would you like to install 'webpack-dev-server' package? (That will run 'npm install -D webpack-dev-server') (Y/n)

FAILURE: Build failed with an exception.

* What went wrong:
Execution failed for task ':samples:todo:webWasmApp:wasmJsBrowserProductionRun'.
> Cannot query the value of task ':samples:todo:webWasmApp:wasmJsBrowserProductionRun' property 'outputDirectory' because it has no value available.
```
